description: Frontend sends one completed spiral drawing; backend returns a risk score plus per-feature breakdown against the UCI reference groups.

schema.x: float[] — CSS pixel X, canvas-relative (clientX minus canvas.getBoundingClientRect().left)
schema.y: float[] — CSS pixel Y, canvas-relative (clientY minus canvas.getBoundingClientRect().top)
schema.t: float[] — DOMHighResTimeStamp in ms, as captured from the PointerEvent (or its coalesced events)
schema.p: float[] — S Pen pressure, 0.0-1.0, real values (not multiplied by any raw digitizer scale)
schema.s: int[] — stroke index, 0-indexed, increments on pen lift
schema.canvas_width: float — CSS pixel width of the canvas element
schema.canvas_height: float — CSS pixel height of the canvas element
schema.device_pixel_ratio: float — window.devicePixelRatio, typically 2.0 on Galaxy Tab S10 FE
schema.pointer_type: string — 'pen' or 'mouse'; backend should skip pressure-derived features if 'mouse'
schema.num_strokes: int — computed as new Set(points.map(p => p.s)).size

normalization_notes: x/y arrays are in CSS pixel space, not physical pixels — do not multiply by device_pixel_ratio.
Normalize coordinates before comparing to UCI: x_norm = (x - canvas_width/2) / (canvas_height/2); y_norm = (y - canvas_height/2) / (canvas_height/2).

Do not multiply pressure by any raw digitizer scale (e.g. 1023) to compare against UCI's Wacom values — Samsung applies a non-linear pressure curve the browser already resolves to 0.0-1.0. Use dimensionless ratios (e.g. std/mean) instead, which cancel hardware-curve differences.
grip_angle is not sent — the browser's PointerEvent API has no equivalent of the UCI dataset's digitizer grip-angle field.

<feature_key>.ctrl_mean: float — mean of the healthy control reference group
<feature_key>.pd_mean: float — mean of the confirmed-PD reference group
<feature_key>.percentile_pd: int, 0-100 — where the patient's value falls on the control→PD spectrum; drives the gauge-bar pin position in the UI

schema.disclaimer: string — must be shown verbatim in the UI

example.interpretation: This drawing shows elevated spiral deviation, reduced pen pressure, and tremor activity in the frequency range associated with Parkinsonian tremor, relative to the healthy reference group.
example.disclaimer: Screening tool only. Not a clinical diagnosis. Please discuss any concerns with a clinician.

reference_dataset.source: UCI Parkinson's Disease Spiral Drawings (dataset ID 395)
reference_dataset.groups: 25 confirmed PD patients, 7 clean healthy controls (C_0002-C_0007, C_0009 — the other 8 of 15 control files have corrupted/wrapped timestamps and must be excluded)
